plan.purpose: Separate queue-aware health routing, admission, and cross-app allocation; no production SLO claim.
plan.limitRule: min(64, max(1, 1 + floor(queueBudgetMs / measured pilot handler-service p95)))

scaler.allocation: dynamic, maximum nine workers including gateway

plan.interpretation: Keep every outcome. Admission rejections are failed arrivals, not faster successful responses. Compare bounded and tie to limited to isolate selection. Report per-run sample counts and p99 resolution; three seeds are diagnostic, not release confidence. Do not pool previous cohorts.
